coverage.summary: The San Francisco Rent Board publishes an annual security deposit interest rate (4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027). The documents do not state which buildings, units or owners the rate applies to.

result.notes: D083 lists only the security deposit interest rates. It gives no unit-count limits, construction-date limits, exemptions or owner conditions for the interest requirement. No other document addresses security deposits. The original summary said the state deposit law operates alongside this rate. None of the documents supports that, so it was removed. Without coverage text, requires_unknown_facts and all coverage fields stay null.
